output.description: The final output of this investigation. The first line must specifically describe the work completed or outcome reached, without a generic heading such as "Conclusion" or "Result". Follow it with an informative markdown summary of the investigation. Reference any file in `/workbench` you mention with a `<plrl-file path="/workbench/..." description="..."></plrl-file>` tag rather than a bare path. You *must* provide this to record a result, and nothing else will be used as the final output.
